MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: This mapping loads FEL_GNRTN_UNIT_DIM from FEL_COMTRAC_GNRTN_UNIT_FDR feeder table Has insert/update logic **************************************************************** *C. Wee 10/15/2011 Created
MAPPING.NAME: m_FEL_COMTRAC_GNRTN_UNIT_DIM_ins_upd

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT MAX(UNIT_KEY) AS MAX_UNIT_KEY FROM FELADM.FEL_GNRTN_UNIT_DIM --

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT MAX(CONSOLIDATION_ID) AS MAX_CONSOLIDATION_ID FROM FELADM.FEL_MASTER_DIM_XRF --

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT dim.UNIT_KEY as UNIT_KEY, dim.UNIT_NM as UNIT_NM, dim.UNIT_STAT_TX as UNIT_STAT_TX, dim.BSNS_ENTY_KEY as BSNS_ENTY_KEY, dim.BSNS_ENTY_NM as BSNS_ENTY_NM, dim.CONSOLIDATION_ID as CONSOLIDATION_ID, dim.CONSOLIDATION_NM as CONSOLIDATION_NM, dim.CNSLDTN_SYS_NM as CNSLDTN_SYS_NM, trim(dim.UNIT_ID) as UNIT_ID, dim.SYSTEM_ID as SYSTEM_ID FROM FELADM.FEL_GNRTN_UNIT_DIM dim

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(NOT ISNULL(LKP_UNIT_KEY), IIF( ( SRC_UNIT_NM <> LKP_UNIT_NM OR SRC_UNIT_STAT_TX <> LKP_UNIT_STAT_TX OR v_BSNS_ENTY_KEY <> LKP_BSNS_ENTY_KEY or v_BSNS_ENTY_NM <> LKP_BSNS_ENTY_NM or SRC_CONSOLIDATION_ID <> LKP_CONSOLIDATION_ID OR MSTR_CONSOLIDATION_NM <> LKP_CONSOLIDATION_NM OR MSTR_CNSLDTN_SYS_NM <> LKP_CNSLDTN_SYS_NM) , 1, 0 ) , 0)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_Changed_Flag

GROUP.DESCRIPTION: Path for the data when none of the group conditions are satisfied.
GROUP.NAME: DEFAULT1

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT XRF.BUSINESS_NM as BUSINESS_NM , SYS.SYS_NM AS SYSTEM_NM , XRF.CONSOLIDATION_ID as CONSOLIDATION_ID , UPPER(XRF.MASTER_FL) as MASTER_FL FROM feladm.FEL_MASTER_DIM_XRF XRF INNER JOIN FELADM.FEL_SYSTEM_DIM SYS ON SYS.SYS_ID = XRF.SYSTEM_ID

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(ISNULL(v_lkp_CONSOLIDATION_ID), IIF(ISNULL(v_lkp_max_consolidation_id), v_next_val , v_lkp_max_consolidation_id + v_next_val), v_lkp_CONSOLIDATION_ID)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_CONSOLIDATION_ID

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT xrf.CONSOLIDATION_ID as CONSOLIDATION_ID , XRF.DATA_TYP_ID as DATA_TYP_ID , XRF.SYSTEM_ID as SYSTEM_ID , upper(trim(XRF.BUSINESS_ID)) as BUSINESS_ID FROM feladm.FEL_MASTER_DIM_XRF xrf

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup condition
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: DATA_TYP_ID = in_DATA_TYP_ID AND SYSTEM_ID = in_SYSTEM_ID AND BUSINESS_ID = in_BUSINESS_ID
